free_tier.stated: no free tier on the pricing page: one subscription for every model, with a weekly credit quota that regenerates 2% every 202 minutes and takes one week to fully regenerate; no card or free-quota terms are stated on the pages read

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key at api.synthetic.new/v1 with syn: model aliases
chaining: pairs with a coding agent through a subscription; infinite mode runs background agents without counting against the rate limit but is for subscribers

limits.value: weekly credit quota regenerating 2% every 202 minutes; no five-hour or monthly limits

binding_note: the weekly regenerating credit quota is the only stated ceiling and binds first

identity_cost.detail: a subscription and API key are required; signup fields and card requirements are not stated on the pricing pages read

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: credits regenerate over the week under a subscription
evidence.quote: One subscription for every model. Credits regenerate over the week and apply at discounted model rates.

evidence.proved: weekly credit limit regenerates incrementally over a week
evidence.quote: Synthetic plans have a weekly credit limit that regenerates over time. Some models consume more of your credits than others, and larger plans have higher limits.

notes: the pricing and rate-limits pages describe a paid subscription only; no free allowance is published.
